entities.name: Kwaro

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan who disowns her cousin Oret.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan Anafenza rules as khan.

entities.name: Oret
entities.description: Anafenza's cousin who betrayed her, murdered her family and destroyed her home.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: Anafenza's brother, who forces Oret to his knees.

entities.name: First Tree

entities.name: Tarkir

events.summary: Kwaro reports to Anafenza that the house leaders are ready, then invites them one by one, leaving Oret for last.
events.quote: Kwaro was then sent to invite the house leaders one by one up to the Khan's dais

events.summary: Gvar forces Oret to his knees.
events.quote: Gvar Barzeel stepped up and forced Oret to his knees

events.summary: Anafenza cuts Oret, performs a blood rite, disowns him and declares him her enemy.
